question.html:
The diagram shows the path of a ball in the absence of air resistance. Q is the highest point of the ball’s trajectory and a is the vertical acceleration at Q. At impact the velocity makes an angle θ to the horizontal.

Three statements about the actual motion of the ball when there is air resistance are:

I.    Q is lower.

II.   a remains the same.

III.  θ increases.

Which statements are correct?

[1]

  1. I and II only
  2. I and III only
  3. II and III only
  4. I, II and III
